correctness.rationale: Full-state amplitude equals (-1)^binom(w,k)/2^(n/2). Lucas congruence and binary carrying remove exactly two cut-local phases. Positive normalized residue superpositions give the exact K matrix. Adjacent F rows differ by a single sign transition, establishing |det F|=2^(k-1) for all dyadic k, so no exceptional finite cut rank can occur. The Fourier residue filter has strict spectral decay at fixed k. Direct second differences prove antiperiodic L(FF^T)=4I, so its half-odd-integer Fourier eigenbasis gives the entire limiting spectrum and rational purity. Pairing modes and a summable odd-square entropy domination permit the iterated entropy limit and the zeta-derivative evaluation. The packaged executable independently checked 38 small complete amplitude matrices, 8 antiperiodic identities and exact purities, 8 finite-to-limit instances, and 1480 root-filter entries; largest direct eigenvalue discrepancy 7.772e-16. The tests are not used to infer the infinite theorem. A simultaneous growing-k limit is expressly not proved.

originality.rationale: On examined evidence, prior papers provide the hypergraph-state framework, a local one-site entropic measure, geometric entanglement and special odd-cardinality symmetric-state decompositions, random-ensemble average entropies, and general partial Schmidt-rank certificates; none of the inspected main statements determines the dyadic complete-state full finite-cut spectrum, antiperiodic limiting eigenvalues, finite purity formula or zeta-derivative iterated finite-entropy limit. The primitive REW phase cleaning, Lucas theorem and Fourier linear algebra are not claimed as original; the exact combined family-specific spectral classification is. Search absence is not proof of novelty, and specialized Boolean-matrix literature remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An uncatalogued specialized symmetric Boolean-function or discrete-matrix spectrum theorem may imply some formulas without using hypergraph-state terminology.
The standard compressed-matrix computation is constructive and could have been performed in earlier work without appearing in titles or search-indexed abstracts.
Historical originality is assessed on accessible literature and relevant searched records, not externally certified.

value.rationale: Complete k-uniform hypergraph states are a canonical permutation-invariant resource generated by many-body gates; arbitrary-cut spectrum and its scaling are physically natural but not fixed by existing one-site entropic or rank-bound measures. The exact all-cut compression reduces exponential-size amplitude matrices to k-by-k matrices while retaining eigenvalue multiplicities. The limiting csc² profile, rational purity 1/3+2/(3k²), and zeta-derivative entropy limit reveal genuinely nonflat, bounded entanglement even as Schmidt rank diverges. These are strong qualitative and quantitative benchmarks for coherent many-body correlation and cut cost, beyond routine small-case tables.
